result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with zero stock. WH-1 with bolts at 10 and nuts and screws at 0 now lists only "Bolt 10", and the nut quantity still answers 0.

The cause was `DataStore.findStockLevelsByWarehouse`, which had no `quantity > 0` filter. The other stock overviews already have one.

Changes:
- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (~line 2107): added `AND s.quantity > 0` to the query and changed its javadoc, which had said zero quantities were included on purpose.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`**: added `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNoStock`, which covers the example above.

The full offline test suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passes, and nothing else in the tests depended on zero-quantity rows. Nothing is committed.
